speaker: lead
text: Has everyone had lunch? I want to keep today's meeting short.

speaker: member_c
text: Yes, we went to the new kalguksu place today. There was a bit of a line, but it was good.

speaker: member_b
text: I heard they make the noodles by hand there. I'm going to try it for lunch tomorrow.

speaker: member_a
text: I just had a packed lunch today. Lunch prices have gone up so much lately.

speaker: member_c
text: Right. Twelve thousand won for one lunch is standard now.

speaker: member_b
text: That's why I've been bringing a packed lunch twice a week too. But getting it ready in the morning is more work than you'd think.

speaker: member_a
text: I make a few extra side dishes the night before and pack those. That's the easiest way for me.

speaker: member_c
text: That's impressive. Just getting up in the morning is hard enough for me.

speaker: lead
text: Tell me about it. Okay, let's get to the main topic. Someone new is joining our team next month. Doyun.

speaker: lead
text: HR sent over the first day, and it's confirmed as Monday, November 3rd. We'll just go with that date too, right?

speaker: member_a
text: Yes, I'll plan on that date.

speaker: member_b
text: Yes, sounds good.

speaker: member_c
text: Monday, November 3rd. I'll write that down.

speaker: member_a
text: What did Doyun do at their previous company?

speaker: lead
text: About two years of data analysis work. In the interview, Doyun came across as calm and detail-oriented.

speaker: member_b
text: With some experience, Doyun should settle in quickly.

speaker: lead
text: Then let's start by getting the laptop and equipment Doyun will use on the first day.

speaker: member_a
text: Since it's development work, a 16-inch laptop would be good. With plenty of memory, too.

speaker: member_c
text: Should we give two monitors? Everyone on our team uses two.

speaker: member_b
text: Yes, two sounds right. With just one, it'll feel cramped pretty quickly.

speaker: member_a
text: Requests to the IT team usually take two weeks. We need to put it in now to have it ready for the first day.

speaker: member_b
text: We should request a keyboard and mouse too. Last time we forgot those, and I ended up lending mine for the whole first week.

speaker: member_a
text: Oh, right, that happened. Let's add a headset too. There are a lot of video calls.

speaker: member_c
text: I'll put in the request to the IT team this afternoon.

speaker: lead
text: Good. Then it's a 16-inch laptop with two monitors, and Haeun will put in the request today.

speaker: member_c
text: Okay, I'll send it today.

speaker: member_b
text: Oh, and about that customer complaint from yesterday, what happened with it?

speaker: lead
text: Ah, that one. The client got in touch saying the numbers in the monthly report were wrong.

speaker: member_b
text: Yes, I checked, and the counting method changed starting this month, but no one told the client.

speaker: member_a
text: So the numbers aren't wrong, the method changed.

speaker: member_b
text: Yes, exactly. But from the client's side, the numbers suddenly dropped, so they were probably caught off guard.

speaker: member_a
text: That contact person is pretty particular to begin with. Last time they called about a single decimal point.

speaker: member_c
text: Still, this time we really should have told them first.

speaker: member_b
text: Yes, the change was our internal decision, so the client had no way of knowing.

speaker: lead
text: We should have told them in advance. Let's write up what changed in the method and send an explanation email today.

speaker: member_c
text: Going forward, whenever the method changes, it'd be good to put even one line about it at the front of the report.

speaker: lead
text: Good idea. Starting with next month's report, let's note any changes on the first page.

speaker: member_b
text: I'll write a draft and get it to you by two.

speaker: member_c
text: Shouldn't we send the same explanation to the other clients too? At least five places get the same report.

speaker: lead
text: Right. Let's send it to those five as well. I'll look at Kenji's draft and send them all at once.

speaker: member_b
text: Should we put the numbers before and after the change side by side in a table in the email?

speaker: lead
text: Yes, a table would be good. Showing the last three months under both methods side by side will make it easy to understand.

speaker: member_a
text: Then I'll rerun the last three months' numbers under the new method and pass them to Kenji.

speaker: member_b
text: Thanks. If I get them by one thirty, I can make the two o'clock deadline.

speaker: member_a
text: That reminds me, have you signed up for next week's company-wide security training? The deadline is this Friday.

speaker: member_c
text: Oh, I haven't yet. That one's online, right?

speaker: member_a
text: Yes, you watch a one-hour video and take a quiz. If you don't do it, your system access gets blocked.

speaker: member_b
text: Last year there were people who got locked out because they skipped that training.

speaker: member_c
text: That quiz is trickier than it looks. I failed it twice last year.

speaker: member_a
text: I heard the questions are different this year. Lots of questions about spotting phishing emails.

speaker: member_b
text: Phishing emails look really convincing these days. Last week I got one asking me to track a package, and I almost clicked it.

speaker: member_c
text: I got one too. The sender's address looked off, so I reported it to the security team.

speaker: lead
text: Everyone sign up today. It'd be a problem if someone can't work because they skipped the training.

speaker: member_c
text: Okay, I'll do it right after the meeting.

speaker: member_b
text: Also, the quarter closes next Friday. Who's putting together the sales figures?

speaker: lead
text: Emily, could you do it like last time?

speaker: member_a
text: Yes, I'll do it. But the finance team's final numbers won't be out until Thursday.

speaker: member_b
text: Last quarter the finance numbers came a day late too, and we were up working until late at night.

speaker: member_a
text: Right. So this time I already asked them to send it by Thursday morning.

speaker: lead
text: Well done. If it's running late, tell me right away. I'll talk to the head of finance again.

speaker: lead
text: Then get it on Thursday and have it organized by Friday morning. Let's go over it together Friday afternoon.

speaker: member_c
text: I have an outside visit Friday afternoon, so I can only do after three.

speaker: member_a
text: Where are you going?

speaker: member_c
text: It's our first regular visit to a client we signed last month. I'm being introduced to their contact person, so I can't miss it.

speaker: lead
text: Then let's make it three thirty.

speaker: member_b
text: Also, when are we doing next month's team dinner? It's the end of the year, so restaurants book up fast.

speaker: lead
text: I'm thinking early December for the team dinner. Let's talk about that separately another time.

speaker: member_c
text: I'll look into a few places for the dinner. The barbecue place we went to last year was a bit noisy.

speaker: member_a
text: I'd like a quiet Korean restaurant. It's easier to talk, too.

speaker: member_b
text: A Korean restaurant sounds good. One with a private room.

speaker: member_a
text: Wasn't the traditional Korean place we went to last year nice? Even if it was a bit far.

speaker: member_b
text: It was nice. But it was thirty minutes by taxi, so getting home afterward was hard.

speaker: lead
text: This time, look for something near the office. If everyone gets home late, the next day is rough.

speaker: member_c
text: I'll look for places with a private room.

speaker: member_b
text: Oh, and could I take next Monday morning off? I have a doctor's appointment.

speaker: lead
text: Yes, that's fine. Put it in the system and I'll approve it.

speaker: member_a
text: I'd also like to take some vacation next month. If I want to use it before the end of the year, when would be good?

speaker: lead
text: The week after the quarter closes is fine. Just let me know ahead of time.

speaker: member_c
text: That reminds me, doesn't everyone still have quite a lot of leave left this year? I still have seven days.

speaker: member_a
text: I have five days left too. It'd be a waste not to use them.

speaker: lead
text: Everyone spread your leave out before the end of the year. Put it on the team calendar ahead of time so it doesn't all pile up at once.

speaker: lead
text: Oh, look at the time already. I have another meeting right after this, so I think we need to wrap up here.

speaker: member_b
text: Oh wait, who's going to be Doyun's mentor? There should be someone to help Doyun from day one.

speaker: lead
text: Ah, we need to decide that too. We're out of time, so let's talk about it at the next meeting.

speaker: member_b
text: Okay, got it.

speaker: lead
text: Good work, everyone.
